technology_name: Process for Preparation of White Pepper
institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
technology_type:
Microbial Food Processing Technology,
Spice Processing Technology
problem_solved: Time-consuming traditional white pepper processing and quality inconsistency
description: This process provides a method for producing white pepper from black pepper using a microbial bioprocess. The technology is designed to selectively remove the pectin layer surrounding the peppercorn while preserving quality. The process reduces processing time compared with conventional methods and supports efficient white pepper production.
applications:
Spice processing and value-addition industries
Pepper producer companies and farmer cooperatives
Export-oriented spice manufacturing enterprises
Food ingredient and seasoning manufacturers
Agri-food startups and specialty spice product companies
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, Consumer & Lifestyle Products, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
